verses.1: And every man of Israel shall be honored in the assembly, and it shall be said: “No man among us shall give his daughter to a young man.”
verses.2: And the people went into the Temple. They sat there until morning, in front of the God. Then they cried out loudly and bowed down in worship.
verses.3: And they said, “Why did Yahweh, the God of Israel, do this? It was in Israel that one ruler would be appointed today.”
verses.4: And in the evening, the people gathered together. They built a altar there, and offered sacrifices.
verses.5: And the children of Israel said, “Who among us did not go up to the LORD from all the tribes of Israel? For it was great an honor for those who did not go up to the LORD. The Lord said, ‘Death will come soon.’”
verses.6: And the sons of Israel went to Gibeah, where their brother Benjamin was. They said, “Today, one of the sons of Israel has been defeated.”
verses.7: What will happen to them as they become women? We shall bless them in the name of God, so that they may not be given to other men as wives.
verses.8: And they said, “Who among the tribes of Israel did not go up to Jehovah, the God of hosts? Who among them did not come to the camp from Gilad to the assembly?”
verses.9: And the people looked around, but they saw that there was not a single person among those who sat in the seats.
verses.10: And they sent there a council of twelve thousand men from among the soldiers. They commanded them to go and take captive the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead, along with their women and children.
verses.11: And this is what every man and woman must do: they must know from the time of conception onward.
verses.12: And they found four young girls who were taken captive by the people of Gilad. No one knew who they were. They brought them to the camp of Shiloh, which was in the land of Canaan.
verses.13: And all the elders sent for them. They spoke to Benjamin’s sons, who were living in the high mountains. They called out to them, “Shalom.”
verses.14: And Benyamin sat down at that time. The women who lived among the women of Zebulun gave them to him. They were not found to be suitable for him.
verses.15: And the people comforted Benjamin, because Jehovah had done miracles in the lands of Israel.
verses.16: And the elders of the court said, “What will happen to those women who are left behind? After all, a woman was killed at the age of fifty.”
verses.17: And they said, “Jerushalem shall be a place of refuge for the people of Benjamin. But the rule of Israel will not be restored.”
verses.18: And we were unable to give them women from our own daughters, because the sons of Israel said, “Aaron shall give a woman to Benjamin.”
verses.19: And they said, “Look! This is the day of Jehovah’s celebration, from ancient times. It was a time when the sun rose from the house of El, and it set at the same place. The sun rose from the house of El, and it set at the same place.”
verses.20: And he commanded the sons of Benjamin, “Go and pluck some fruit from the trees.”
verses.21: And when you saw that the daughters of Shilo went out into the fields to work in the fields, then you also rushed out from among the trees. You took one of their wives from among the daughters of Shilo, and you went away to live in the land of silver.
verses.22: And it will be like when their fathers or relatives come to fight against us. We said to them, “Let us forgive them, for we did not take any of their wives in the war. After all, you yourselves have given them those women.”
verses.23: And so did the sons of Benjamin. They took women from among those who were captured as slaves, and they went and returned to their own land. They built cities and settled there.
verses.24: And in that time, the children of Israel went away from there. Each person went to their own land and family. They left there, each going to his own place.
verses.25: In those days, there will be no king in Israel who is worthy of being called a “righteous man.”
